summary: A developer smoke client safely discovers remote machines and optionally performs an explicit read or approved-start mutation without automatic retries.
trigger: Developer runs the Worker smoke script with an HTTPS API base URL and private client credential file.

steps.action: Require an absolute, private, bounded owner-only credential file; validate HTTPS base URL (HTTP only with explicit loopback allowance), and submit Access-authenticated machine discovery with redirects disabled and a 10-second deadline.
Print validated discovery; default invocation exits without mutations. Optional read or start requires an explicit machine that is online with a host generation.

For approved start, require explicit profile, generate command and target IDs, log complete non-secret intent before dispatch, then validate result. On failure, distinguish pre-mutation from unknown post-attempt outcome and never retry automatically.
